title: sigil:media_buyer:v1 — AIT constraints
description: Validates the `constraints` object of an ATAP v0.1 AIT declared under the sigil:media_buyer:v1 profile. The canonical-byte serialization of `constraints` MUST NOT exceed 4096 bytes (ATAP v0.1 §6.2).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for all monetary amounts in this AIT's events.

max_bid_cpm.description: Maximum cost-per-mille the agent may bid.

supply_trust_minimum.description: Minimum Sigil trust score (0-1) the agent must observe before bidding on a supply path.

budget_total_cap.description: Total spend ceiling over the AIT lifetime.

blocked_domains.description: Publisher domains the agent must not bid on. Capped at 100 to respect the 4 KB constraints ceiling.

blocked_categories.description: IAB content categories the agent must not bid on.

geo_targeting.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country gating. Country, never sub-national or user-resolvable geo (ATAP v0.1 §7.6).
